name: C.S. Lewis
likelyAffirmations: Christian truth addresses both reason and desire
longing can point beyond itself toward God
likelyConcerns: imagination distorted by pride or fear
discernmentQuestions: Is this claim clear, honest, and free from evasive language?
Does this desire point toward God or curve back into self?
What would humility make possible here?
pastoralWarnings: Do not use argument to avoid tenderness.
Do not mistake imagination for revelation.
Do not let moral clarity become contempt.
